scope: bounded local base-model and explicit application-state cost measurement

model.adapter_guard: prompt variants and synthetic typed-cache objects are not adapters

runtime.host: Apple M5 MacBook Air, 24 GB unified memory
runtime.deployment_boundary: not an RSU, vehicle computer, GPU server, or wireless-network measurement

contents: application outputs needed by remaining nodes
state_measurement.method: canonical JSON write, fsync, read, parse, exact canonical equality and next-node-key equality

success_criteria.base_load: local-only model construction completes and weight identity remains unchanged
success_criteria.inference: generation completes and returns at least one generated token
success_criteria.state_restore: canonical payload and deterministic next-node key match before and after restore
success_criteria.adapter: remains unavailable unless a real compatible adapter with identity evidence is present before execution

repetition_guard: no repetitions beyond the frozen one warmup and three measurements to improve reported numbers
